thread:
Riley (Platform Architect): Heads-up — I want to capture the product asks + launch gating for the policy-template initiative (multi-region + multi-tenant isolation). I sketched 3 core gates: 1) telemetry & invariant checks, 2) chaos-tested failover, 3) SLO-backed canary rollouts. Thoughts?

Asha (PM): +1. Also need a canary window definition and a simple cost-delta estimate per tenant band. Customer stakeholders keep asking for explicit rollback criteria.

Diego (Eng): From infra side: we can implement per-tenant routing templates + fallback lanes. Implementation concerns: kernel pinning for latency-sensitive models, KV cache warmup for rollouts, and a cheap isolation mode (soft-shield) vs full-shield. Need a spike to measure cold-kv penalty.

Sam (SRE): Runbooks first. We need evacuation runbook and an "evacuation_time" SLI (target <= 5m for P1). Also add an automated canary abort if 95p latency regresses >30%. Load test plan should simulate tenant surges + region blackout.

Maya (Customer Success): Two mid-market customers want staged private-plane cutovers (VPC-only) and will accept a 2-week canary per region. They require audit logs and KMS integration before final switch.

Lea (Product): Need to tie launch criteria to business metrics: MRR at-risk, onboarding time, and support load. Also request Optimize team to provide suggested quantization profiles — show 10–20% cost saving estimates for recommended lanes.

Diego (Eng): Proposed minimal canary config (example):

```
canary: 
  duration: 14d
  traffic: [
    {percentage: 5, tenants: curated-small},
    {percentage: 20, tenants: curated-medium}
  ]
  abort_conditions:
    latency_p95_increase_pct: 30
    error_rate_absolute: 0.5
```

Diego (Eng): Notes: curated sets must include a mix of seq len / model variants. We'll need a lightweight authz flag per tenant for private plane.

Sam (SRE): Also add chaos tests that simulate cross-region db latency + node eviction. If failover times > 2x target, hold launch.

Asha (PM): For prioritization: Q2 runway items = telemetry portion (invariant checks, telemetry dashboards), Q3 = canary infra + runbooks, Q4 = customer cutovers + policy catalog. Put high-touch customers into a "pilot" lane.

Maya (Customer Success): Confirming: pilot lane customers = Acme Co, BrightLeaf, OrbitalDocs. I'll start collecting audits & KMS reqs.

Riley (Platform Architect): Decision proposals:
- Launch gates: telemetry, chaos, canary.
- Minimal acceptance: stable telemetry for 2 weeks, 3 successful canaries per region, runbook verified by SRE.
- Fallback policy: automatic downgrade to generic open-model endpoint + notify on-call.

routing-bot: deploy-check — policy-template-canary: queued -> started on infra-canary-1 (1716004400).

Lea (Product): We should also list non-goals: this phase will not include per-tenant SLA contracts or billed reserved capacity. Those are separate dedicated-Dedicated workstreams.

Diego (Eng): Action items:
- spike: kv cache cold penalty (owner: Diego) // due: 2w
- infra: canary engine config + abort hooks (owner: Eng-Platform) // due: 4w
- tests: chaos scenarios + runbooks (owner: SRE) // due: 4w

Sam (SRE): I'll draft eviction runbook and the automated abort playbook.

Asha (PM): I'll make the PRD with launch gates + customer checklist; ping me if you need customer acceptance criteria.

Maya (Customer Success): I'll collect security artifacts from pilot customers and confirm KMS timelines.

Riley (Platform Architect): Ok — pulling these into the roadmap board. Next sync Friday 10:30am to review spike outcomes and the initial telemetry dashboard mock. :thumbsup:
